objective: Gate 5I quirurgico: corregir exclusivamente el bootstrap Python del harness Agent-Reach Live Canary para instalar las dependencias publicas canonicas del backend usando exactamente el patron ya usado por worker-full-gate.yml: backend/requirements.txt excluyendo emergentintegrations. Esto evita seguir agregando modulos uno por uno y resuelve conftest.py/python-dotenv y cualquier otra dependencia publica requerida para cargar el test. Mantener intactos Agent Reach, ejecutores, policy/capability, Worker, Supervisor, watchdog y Produccion. Reutilizar el mismo marcador controlado para auto-disparar un unico nuevo live canary. No secrets, no docker.sock, no mounts, no deploy, no image push.

actions.content:
name: Agent-Reach Live Canary

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      expected_sha:
        description: Exact Edarsahub_Desarrollo SHA to certify
        required: true
        type: string
  push:
    branches:
      - Edarsahub_Desarrollo
    paths:
      - backend/tests/live_canary_requests/gate5g_worker_autotrigger_20260914.json

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  live-canary:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.expected_sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.EXPECTED_SHA }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify exact SHA
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
          echo "EXACT_SHA_CHECK=PASS"

      - name: Build canonical Agent-Reach image
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          infra/agent-reach/build.sh

      - name: Set up Python test runtime
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: backend/requirements.txt

      - name: Install public backend dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          grep -v '^emergentintegrations==' backend/requirements.txt > /tmp/requirements-ci.txt
          python -m pip install -r /tmp/requirements-ci.txt

      - name: Execute real live canary
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export PYTHONPATH=backend
          python -m pytest -q backend/tests/test_agent_reach_live_network_canary.py

      - name: Upload sanitized live evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: agent-reach-live-canary-evidence-${{ env.EXPECTED_SHA }}
          path: backend/tests/agent_reach_live_network_canary_evidence.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
